sovereign_country.strategic_role: 海湾阿拉伯国家自贸走廊、外资100%控股与印度洋海运枢纽

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of PC and Console Video Games via Digital Stores

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: Codified Civil Law with Islamic Sharia influences; unitary national legal system without sub-state tax distinctions
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Oman-United States Free Trade Agreement (in force 2009)
Oman-United Kingdom Free Trade Agreement (signed January 2024)
Unified Agreement for the Investment of Arab Capital in the Arab Countries (Arab League / GCC)
Oman-France Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement and other OECD-aligned DTAs

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Royal Decree No. 30/2016 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing, as amended by Royal Decree No. 7/2021; Royal Decree No. 18/2019 promulgating the Commercial Companies Law; MoCIIP Decision No. 181/2021 establishing the Beneficial Owner Register and related filing duties; Central Bank of Oman AML/CFT Executive Regulations; directives of the National Committee for Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing; FATF Recommendations 2012-2023.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing of the ultimate parent/entity (if any)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney in favor of the Omani incorporation law firm / registered agent
Notarized certified copies of passports of all ultimate beneficial owners and the appointed manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country notary public or issuing passport authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-wealth statement for UBOs and funding sources
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate or private bank of the investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization where the issuing bank is located in a non-Hague state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country police or civil registration authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board / shareholders resolution approving the incorporation of the Omani SPC, its capital and first manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary / board of the investing entity

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, officers, and the resident manager against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List (required due to Steam/Valve and PlayStation Store US payment rails), EU and UK consolidated sanctions, Omani Central Bank restricted lists, and MoCIIP administrative exclusions. PEP screening applies FATF definitions under RD 30/2016: foreign PEPs are always treated as high-risk; domestic PEPs enjoy a 5-year post-cession cooling-off period before standard risk classification. Enhanced Due Diligence and source-of-funds documentation are required for any hit or negative-news disclosure; confirmed matches trigger a Suspicious Transaction Report to the Omani Financial Intelligence Unit.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Sijilat - National One-Stop-Shop Online Trade Registration Platform of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The commercial name must be filed and reserved in Arabic; a Latin-script transliteration is accepted for the bilingual Commercial Registration certificate. The name must contain a distinguishing personal or invented element and must end with the mandatory legal-form suffix for a Single Person Company: 'SPC' in English or 'Shirkat al-Shakhs al-Wahid' in Arabic. Naming doctrine rejects acronym-only names, numeric-only names, and names implying a corporate form different from the registered SPC structure.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Al Said royal family surnames and all names of the ruling family
Identical or phonetically confusing names of existing registered companies or registered trademarks
Religious or sectarian connotations not justified by the business scope
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written grievance with the Director-General of Commercial Registration and Investment Services at MoCIIP within 15 days of the rejection notice; MoCIIP must respond within 10 working days. If the grievance is dismissed, a further administrative appeal lies to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion within 30 days, followed by judicial review before the Omani Administrative Court. A parallel pragmatic remedy is immediate re-submission of a modified distinctive name against a new reservation fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permissible: MoCIIP and the competent municipality accept serviced offices, business centers, and smart-office addresses for a low-risk digital publishing SPC, provided an executed sub-lease or use authorization is uploaded to Sijilat. A pure mail-forwarding address without any physical presence is not accepted for Commercial Registration issuance and would be disregarded by the Oman Tax Authority for economic-substance verification.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate, quantified at approximately 15-20% annual probability for a non-licensed, cashless digital publisher; municipal commercial-license field visits are the most frequent trigger, and MoCIIP registration auditors may verify the registered office during the first operating year.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree No. 18/2019) as amended; Arts. 2, 12–17 and the Single Person Company provisions; implementing regulations of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Companies Registration Directorate via the Oman Business Platform (business.gov.om) and the Sijil electronic register.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association, submitted electronically and legally attested, resulting in the issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation and the Commercial Registration Certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No mandatory minimum paid-up capital applies to a Single Person Company under the Commercial Companies Law as amended. The issued capital must be stated in the Memorandum of Association and deposited in an Omani bank account held in the company's name; a bank letter confirming inward capital transfer is acceptable for foreign shareholders.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the sole shareholder subscribes to and accepts all shares of the Company issued against the paid-up capital, fully paid up in cash in accordance with the Memorandum of Association. FURTHER RESOLVED THAT the registered office of the Company shall be [address], Muscat Governorate, Sultanate of Oman, which shall be the statutory address for service, notices and official correspondence. FURTHER RESOLVED THAT [name] is appointed General Manager, and [name] is appointed Company Secretary/Finance Officer, each with authority to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and file the Company's Commercial Registration, municipal, tax and Civil Defense licenses. ANY residual powers are delegated to the General Manager in accordance with the Commercial Companies Law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Corporate Legal Name Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Companies Registration Directorate, Oman Business Platform (business.gov.om)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the electronic register and submit a company name request in Arabic or an accepted English transliteration, selecting 'Single Person Company' and 'Software Publishing - ISIC 5820'. Attach the shareholder passport. No notarization is required at this stage. Pay the name reservation fee online and obtain a 30-day name availability certificate.
required_dossiers: Clear passport copy of sole shareholder
Activity description matching ISIC 5820 digital game publishing
Contact details and proposed registered office location
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to similarity or prohibited meaning, file an administrative appeal with the Companies Registration Directorate and submit up to two alternative names within 10 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Attestation of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public licensed by the Ministry of Justice and Legal Affairs, Sultanate of Oman
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Arabic Memorandum and Articles of Association in the Sijil model form, specifying the foreign-owned SPC structure, share capital, registered office address, and sole shareholder. Appear before a licensed Notary Public or submit an authenticated power of attorney. Have any English copy certified for bank and tax use.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Passport or valid residence/entry visa of shareholder, or notarized power of attorney
Statement of share capital and payment schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries identity or authority, obtain an apostilled or embassy-attested power of attorney and present the original passport; re-submit notarization within 7 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Incorporation Filing and Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Companies Registration Directorate via the Oman Business Platform / Sijil electronic register
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the notarized MOA/AOA, name certificate, shareholder identification, and corporate governance statement. Complete the electronic declaration of compliance with the Commercial Companies Law. Upon approval, the system issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the Commercial Registration number with the activity code for digital software publishing. Download the Commercial Registration certificate before further permits.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Power of attorney if signed by a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a query, provide translated clarifications, pay the correction fee, and re-file within 14 days; retain the issue log to avoid duplicate rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipality Operating Permit and Chamber of Commerce Membership
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality Business Licensing Department and Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After CR issuance, register the physical office lease with Muscat Municipality and apply for the electronic business license for 'Software Publishing and Digital Gaming Platform Operations'. Simultaneously join OCCI to obtain the membership card required for labor visa sponsorship. The municipality license will reference civil defense and sanitation approvals.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality queries the use of premises, update the lease purpose to 'information technology/office' and resubmit the zoning certificate; a re-inspection may be conducted within 5 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Oman Tax, VAT and Social Protection Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority and Social Protection Fund (National Social Insurance)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: On receipt of the CR certificate, file the corporate income tax registration, VAT registration if projected taxable supplies exceed the OMR 38,500 threshold, and employer registration for social security. Submit the board resolution designating a tax manager and resident premises. Obtain the income tax card and VAT certificate, which payment processors require for Steam and PlayStation Store payout validation.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Registration
Memorandum and Articles of Association in Arabic/English
Board resolution appointing a tax officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is blocked for any pending corporate record, reconcile with MoCIIP and OCCI; penalty relief may be requested before the first return deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Civil Defense Clearance, Labor Registration and Premises Readiness
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Royal Oman Police - General Directorate of Civil Defense and Ambulance; Ministry of Labor
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the office floor plan and fire-hazard assessment for a Class B low-risk ICT office. Civil Defense issues an occupancy clearance after an on-site inspection, then the company registers staff under the Labor Law and obtains work permits. For computer equipment rooms, provide structural load certification from a licensed engineer and server rack anchoring.
required_dossiers: Fire extinguisher maintenance contract and fire alarm certificate
Structural load certificate for equipment racks if self-managed server equipment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If Civil Defense identifies fire load violations, install required extinguishers and signage, pay the re-inspection fee, and obtain the second inspection within 7 days; labor deficiencies require standard visa filing corrections.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Trade and Business Regulations Department and Municipal Business Licensing Center for digital service industries
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Premises Operating License for Digital Content Publication (ISIC 5820 / NAICS 511210), issued as an electronic commercial license by MoCIIP and the municipal authority

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman (formerly Ministry of Environment and Climate Affairs)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category D - exempt from a full EIA study for office-based video game publishing; an environmental self-registration applies if the premises uses diesel generators or involves structural conversion. No environmental licensing condition is imposed on Steam/PlayStation store operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process discharges; sanitary sewage must connect to the municipal sewer system; e-waste and non-functional ICT hardware must be handled by licensed waste operators under Oman Waste Management Regulations; any indoor generator and air-conditioning systems must comply with municipal noise limits and diesel smoke opacity requirements.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Certificate issued by the Royal Oman Police after fire safety inspection of premises load capacity, evacuation signage, emergency exits, electrical panels, and fire extinguishers rated for electrical risk; occupational clearance by the Ministry of Labor requiring compliant lighting, ventilation, and ergonomic workstations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Sultanate of Oman – Tax Authority (Oman Tax Authority, OTA) under the Ministry of Finance; official e-services portal: taxoman.gov.om
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC): (1) obtain Commercial Registration from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion through the Invest Oman portal; (2) after incorporation, register for Income Tax with the Oman Tax Authority via OTA e-services within 90 days of commencement of business; (3) register for VAT separately via OTA e-services if taxable turnover exceeds the mandatory threshold or as a voluntary registrant; (4) the OTA issues a consolidated Tax Identification Number (TIN) and separate VAT Identification Number used for all tax filings, e-invoices, and customs declarations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime. The SPC is taxed at entity level under the Income Tax Law. Elective mechanisms include: voluntary VAT registration at OMR 100,000 annual turnover; VAT group registration for related Omani entities; election to file consolidated/tax-group income tax returns under specific ownership conditions; and election to apply customs duty exemptions under GCC unified rules. No hybrid mismatch or check-the-box elections are available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT under the GCC VAT Framework and Oman VAT Law – Unified VAT Agreement)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration: OMR 500,000 annual taxable supplies in Oman; voluntary registration: OMR 100,000 annual taxable supplies (Omani Rial)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman has initiated an e-invoicing framework but as of the current compliance stage there is no mandatory real-time fiscal clearance or central digital stamping system. Taxpayers must issue electronic invoices in XML or PDF/A-3 format readable by OTA systems, submit VAT returns and data through the OTA e-services portal API/EDI channels, and maintain invoice integrity controls. Future phased e-invoicing clearance requirements are expected to align with GCC practices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to: (a) physical goods exported outside the GCC with customs export proof and satisfying the time limits; (b) international/offshore services supplied to a non-resident recipient outside Oman where the service is not performed or enjoyed in Oman; (c) services directly related to exported goods. Digital game sales through Steam and PlayStation Store to non-resident platforms or end-consumers abroad qualify as zero-rated export services if the supply is beneficially provided to a person located outside Oman and adequate documentary evidence demonstrating non-resident receipt and absence of Omani consumption is retained.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (for physical export cases)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill (for physical export cases)
Export invoice and commercial contract evidencing the cross-border digital supply
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank settlement proof from an Omani licensed bank evidencing receipt of sale proceeds
Evidence of non-resident status of the platform or end-customer (e.g., VAT registration certificate, residence certificate, IP address/geolocation report for digital downloads)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Oman Tax Authority may audit export zero-rating claims and retrospectively claw back improperly claimed input VAT or unassessed output VAT for an assessment period of six years. Administrative fines apply under the VAT Law, including a late-payment penalty generally of 1% per day on unpaid tax, fines up to OMR 10,000 for record-keeping and procedural violations, and full reversal of input VAT credits. Fraudulent or deliberately abusive zero-rating is treated as tax evasion, subject to criminal referral, imprisonment, and fines up to OMR 100,000 under Omani penal and tax law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) — Exchange Control Division and External Sector Statistics Department
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is fully convertible for the current account; Oman has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations and imposes no exchange control permits for trade or digital services exports. The capital account is liberalized for a 100% foreign-owned Single Person Company. Profit and dividend remittance to a non-resident shareholder is permitted without CBO approval, subject only to corporate income tax clearance and batching through the designated domestic settlement bank. The OMR is pegged to the USD at a fixed official rate of 1 USD = 0.3845 OMR (mid-rate), effectively eliminating USD/OMR conversion risk.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or compulsory conversion applies in Oman. Export receipts from Steam, PlayStation and other digital storefronts may be retained offshore or remitted at the entity's discretion. No statutory repatriation deadline exists; however, the CBO requires the settlement bank to report all resident corporate foreign asset movements under its Balance of Payments statistical framework, and bank clients must attach commercial invoices and platform payout statements for each inbound credit.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low regulatory viability for offshore digital EMIs. The CBO has not licensed foreign electronic money institutions (Wise, Payoneer, Mercury, Revolut Business) to hold Omani corporate accounts. CBO resolution measures require all resident businesses to settle treasury flows through an onshore licensed bank; an offshore EMI may be used only as a supplementary receivable collection rail and must not be the sole treasury concentration point. Domestic fintech PSPs operate under CBO Open Banking regulations but largely target payroll and e-wallet use, not cross-border trade settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical presence at onboarding. Under CBO KYC Circular and Oman AML Law (Royal Decree 46/2016, as amended), the shareholder-manager and at least one authorized signatory of the SPC must attend an in-person interview at the branch with original passports, original Power of Attorney, and authenticated Commercial Register documents from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP). Remote video-KYC is not accepted for opening a first business relationship. Subsequent treasury operations run fully digitally via the bank's corporate internet banking portal.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume inbound foreign-currency digital storefront credits (Steam, PlayStation) with no physical goods movement or tax-deductible invoices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized platform publishing agreements with Valve Corporation and Sony Interactive Entertainment; 12-month revenue forecast; Steam Partner Hub and PlayStation Partner sales reconciliations; AML source-of-funds declaration; certificate of incorporation; MOCIIP commercial registration extract; capital authorization board resolution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Periodic foreign-currency disbursements to overseas software developers, artists and engine licensing vendors presented as business services.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed IP ownership and contractor agreements; task-level invoices; live contributor portal screenshots; beneficial ownership register; CBO purpose code for Business Software Services; historical tax filings; proof of professional liability or escrow arrangements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large, lumpy shareholder capital injections from UAE or DIFC holding entities prior to substantive game publishing activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized capital contribution certificate; shareholder wealth statement; commercial bank reference of the parent; board resolution of the remitter; CBO FDI statistical notification; statement of intended use linked to consented treasury cash flows; signed audited annual financial projections.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Wire via SWIFT MT103 (field 70) using the purpose code 'Foreign Direct Investment — Equity Contribution to Omani SPC' plus the MOCIIP registration reference. A USD-equivalent OMR conversion is performed automatically by the receiving bank at the pegged rate without CBO approval; the bank files the CBO External Sector Statistics report within five business days. Standard documentary pack: board resolution, shareholders' list, Commercial Register extract, bank KYC forms, and the source-of-funds declaration. For injections above OMR 100,000, the bank requires the audited statement of the contributing entity.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Royalty disbursements and platform fee payments from the Omani treasury to Valve, Sony and subcontractors are cleared via SWIFT MT103 over the correspondent network of HSBC Bank Oman, Bank Muscat or Bank Dhofar using the 'Business Services: Software Rights' purpose code. Commercial Letters of Credit are not required for digital goods publishing. For vendor payroll and AWS/GCP infrastructure invoices, MT103 GPI with 24-hour settlement is applied; local OMR payments are settled via OmanNet RTGS. All outbound payments above USD 10,000 require invoice-level rationalization.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore FX outright forwards (short-dated, 1-12 months) in EUR, GBP and JPY against USD for receivables from non-USD Steam and PlayStation store regions
Off-balance-sheet cross-currency swaps (USD interest-rate basis) executed through CBO-compliant bank dealing rooms

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing OMR are restricted to offshore execution; onshore NDF documentation is not a standard CBO product, so synthetic alternatives are limited to physically settled forwards with bank term sheets
Structural USD/OMR pegged-rate hedging (zero residual risk via the fixed 1 USD = 0.3845 OMR linkage; no hedge instrument required for USD-denominated platform payouts)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of the Commercial Registration (CR) for the Single Person Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) – Commercial Registry via the Invest Easy portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the CR anniversary date; renewal window opens 30 days before expiry and the licence is valid for one calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal accrues additional daily/monthly late fees (approx. OMR 20–50); trading under an expired CR is a regulatory contravention; suspension follows and continued non-renewal beyond 12 months triggers administrative strike-off and cancellation by MoCIIP.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) return and settlement of final tax liability
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the tax accounting period (30 April following a 31 December year-end); extension available upon prior application
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts administrative fines (OMR 100–500) plus a late-payment charge of up to 1% per month on unpaid CIT; continued default triggers default assessment, penalty escalation, enforced collection, and blocking of CR renewal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of the Register of Beneficial Owners (UBO) and disclosure of any shareholding transfers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Registry – Beneficial Ownership Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on CR renewal; additionally updated within 30 days after any share transfer or change in beneficial interest
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or false UBO declarations attract administrative fines of OMR 500–5,000, suspension of CR renewal, blocking of corporate transactions, and criminal liability for the managing director for submitting inaccurate natural-person data.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting (AGM) resolutions approving the SPC's audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate record – minutes maintained in the statutory minute book as prescribed by the Commercial Companies Law (RD 18/2019)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months from the financial year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-holding of the AGM or non-approval of accounts breaches the Commercial Companies Law; the auditor's report is qualified and the resident manager/shareholder may be personally fined; persistent default invites MoCIIP intervention and strike-off risk.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual membership subscription renewal with the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, concurrent with the Commercial Registration renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Lapse of the OCCI certificate prevents CR renewal, restricts customs facilitation and government e-service access; arrears incur membership late fees.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual declaration to the Social Protection Fund (SPF) for registered employees (if the SPC becomes an employer)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Social Protection Fund (SPF) – employer registration and contribution branch
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual declaration by 31 January for the preceding contribution year; monthly payroll contributions due by the 15th of the following month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late remittance incurs monthly late-payment fines (2% per month) and employer criminal sanctions under the Social Protection Law; repeated default is escalated to the Ministry of Labour for administrative action.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the Commercial Companies Law (RD 18/2019), every LLC/SPC must appoint at least one auditor licensed in Oman and registered with the Oman Association of Auditors and Accountants (OAAA). Independent statutory audit is mandatory if the SPC's issued paid-up capital equals or exceeds OMR 500,000, annual turnover equals or exceeds OMR 2,000,000, or the workforce is 50 or more employees; smaller SPCs may be exempted from the mandatory external audit only where the sole member so resolves, but an audit is always required upon OTA request, shareholder direction, or lender/creditor requirement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted for Oman (Oman GAAP aligned to IFRS); the CIT return is computed from accounting profit adjusted for non-deductible and tax-exempt items under the Oman Income Tax Law.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SPC must maintain a Register of Beneficial Owners at its registered office and file or reconfirm the UBO data electronically with MoCIIP on every CR renewal and within 30 days after any direct/indirect share transfer or change in voting or control rights. Beneficial owners are natural persons directly or indirectly holding more than 10% of issued shares or exercising ultimate control over the SPC; the resident manager or legal representative is accountable for accurate, timely filing, and any false declaration triggers administrative penalties and CR suspension.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 780–1,560 per annum (registered office, PO Box and local commercial agency in Muscat)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 780–2,600 per annum for a licensed Omani auditor for a low-risk digital publishing SPC

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday applies to a foreign-owned Single Person Company engaged in digital publishing. The preferential zero rate applicable to the first OMR 30,000 of taxable income is confined to qualifying Omani-owned small enterprises; the SPC therefore generally bears a 15% rate on Oman-source net profits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: OTA e-Services Portal (taxoman.gov.om) – Corporate Income Tax Return Form (Form 1) for juridical persons under the Income Tax Law, Sultani Decree No. 28/2009 as amended
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (tax year equals the accounting year unless an approved different financial year is adopted)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and payment due within four months from the end of the tax year; for a 31 December year-end, the statutory deadline is the following 30 April.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax Identification Number, legal form of the taxpayer, Commercial Registration number, and the fiscal period covered by the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Omani SPC's TIN and Commercial Registration; identify the sole corporate shareholder in the accompanying ownership schedule but do not substitute the non-resident parent as the declarant.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross receipts from Steam, PlayStation Store, Nintendo eShop, and other digital storefront sales, inclusive of in-game microtransactions and downloadable content, net of refunds and platform chargebacks.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile to Valve and Platform payout statements and convert foreign-currency remittances to OMR using the Omani Central Bank exchange rate on each transaction date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Other operating income, including store bonuses, promotional subsidies, licensing fees received from sub-publication, and rebates from payment processors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all amounts connected to Oman-publication activities, including amounts routed through a foreign payment service provider; there is no offshore-receipt exclusion for an Omani tax-resident SPC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses: platform commissions, game development amortization, Steamworks fees, external art and localization services, server hosting, salaries, rent, and legal costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach an audited IFRS financial statement; disallow royalties to affiliates unless the payer demonstrates arm's-length rates, actual services support, and OTA-compliant transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjusted taxable income before relief: accounting profit reconciled to fiscal profit through Schedule M-type adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include any withholding taxes, management fees, or non-business payments made to the sole shareholder that are not deductible under anti-referencing and CFC provisions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prior-year tax losses carried forward, limited to five years from the loss year and available only against Oman-source taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute loss relief sequentially oldest-first; no group relief or loss surrender from foreign sister entities is permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after loss relief and the corresponding corporate income tax at 15%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the foreign-owned SPC, do not apply the OMR 30,000 Omani-owned small enterprise exemption; apply 15% to the full taxable amount except where a tax treaty or DTA provision expressly applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits and advance payments: provisional income tax paid during the year, foreign withholding tax credit eligible under a DTA, and any statutory prepayment certificates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No unilateral foreign tax credit is available for non-treated jurisdictions; claim treaty credits only by attaching the relevant OTA-approved TRC and treaty article mapping.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax due or refundable after applying credits, to be paid via the OTA e-Payment system.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment must be settled by the same statutory deadline; late remittance is not cured by presentation of a foreign tax liability or pending parent-company transfer payment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a statutory monetary penalty of not less than OMR 100 and not more than OMR 1,000, plus an additional daily surcharge for continued default. Late payment of assessed tax triggers a recurring late-payment charge of 20% per annum on the outstanding amount. Deliberate false declarations are treated as tax evasion and attract criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% – Oman does not impose dividend withholding tax on distributions made by an Omani SPC to its foreign shareholder under the domestic Income Tax Law.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because the domestic dividend withholding rate is nil, no DTA relief procedure is necessary in respect of pure profit distributions. If treaty relief is sought on other Omani-source remittances, such as royalties or fees, the payer must submit an OTA relief request through the e-Services portal together with a certified Tax Residency Certificate from the beneficial owner's jurisdiction; the payer must apply the domestic rate and charge the tax until the OTA has formally confirmed the treaty reduction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory rules treat non-resident royalty income sourced in Oman as taxable at the 15% corporate rate on a gross basis where no permanent establishment exists. Interest paid to non-residents is generally not subject to a domestic Omani withholding tax, but it may be recharacterized as a non-deductible thin-capitalization item when paid to a related party. Under Oman DTAs, treaty rates commonly reduce royalty withholding to 5%–10% and interest to 0%–10%, subject to submission of a valid Tax Residency Certificate and satisfaction of the beneficial-ownership test.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File obligations arise under the Oman Tax Authority Transfer Pricing Guidelines when annual Omani turnover exceeds OMR 2 million and cross-border related-party transactions exceed OMR 200,000 during the tax period.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Oman has not enacted standalone UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations. However, the tax authority applies the Income Tax Law, treaty residence, and anti-abuse principles to require demonstrable place of effective management, operational staff, local bank accounts, and decision-making in Oman. A Single Person Company that is a mere booking vehicle for Steam or PlayStation publishing revenue, without physical substance or actual management, is vulnerable to reclassification as a conduit entity and loss of treaty benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Understating or omitting Steam, PlayStation Store, or eShop revenues, routing digital-store remittances through foreign affiliate bank accounts, or submitting materially false tax returns to the Omani Tax Authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal prosecution under the Income Tax Law, Sultani Decree No. 28/2009; fines reaching three times the evaded tax, daily late-payment penalties, interest, and an entitlement of the OTA to seize assets. The offense carries possible imprisonment of up to five years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors or shadow directors who execute a false return become jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax. The OTA may impose civil restitution, stop bank and payment-processor accounts, issue a travel ban, and penalize the corporate veil-piercing on the resident manager or sole shareholder representative.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately maintaining the SPC as a registered shell with no office, employees, evidence of contractual activity, or management decisions, while directing all substantive publishing decisions through a foreign beneficial owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Application of the Oman anti-abuse rules and place-of-effective-management tests; disregard of the SPC as a separate taxable person; reassessment of profits to the foreign beneficial owner; cancellation of Commercial Registration and digital store tax identification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil piercing extends personal liability for corporate tax debts to nominee directors; directors face director disqualification, entry bans for up to five years, civil restitution to the Oman Tax Authority, and asset attachment for the unremitted tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying excessive royalties or license fees to a related offshore intellectual-property holding entity for game code, trademarks, or platform rights without performing any demonstrable services, or burdening the Omani SPC with artificial affiliate debt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Omani Tax Authority may reprice the related-party transaction on an arm's-length basis under an approved methodology. The resulting tax shortfall is subject to 15% income tax plus a late-payment surcharge of 20% per annum; improper documentation can also lead to substantial fixed penalties and loss of the royalty deduction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Deliberate transfer-pricing manipulation is treated as tax evasion when disguised as a sham transaction. Officers who contract for or authorize the sham royalty arrangement are jointly liable for the assessed deficiency and may be subject to civil penalties, bank account freezes, and travel restrictions pending settlement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Committing funds from grey-market digital game keys, processing store payments through unlicensed third-party digital wallets, failing to apply customer due diligence, or transacting with sanctioned entities through Steam or PlayStation marketplaces.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under Oman's Anti-Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism Law, Sultani Decree No. 30/2016: mandatory disclosure obligations, confiscation of assets linked to the unlawful proceeds, fines, and imprisonment for money laundering of up to five years in serious cases.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers who knowingly permit money laundering or conceal payment-chain relationships incur personal criminal liability, including imprisonment, seizure of personal assets, and prohibition from serving as director of any licensed corporate entity in Oman.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Register and File as a Taxable Digital Publisher
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the SPC as an unregistered offshore entity while maintaining a commercial presence, billing address, payment processor, or Steamworks registration in Oman, and completely failing to file corporate income tax returns or pay the 15% tax on Oman-source publishing profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Back-assessment for at least five years of unreported income, late filing penalties, daily compliance penalties, a 20% per annum surcharge on unpaid tax, and potential criminal referral for intentional non-registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The responsible director and any de facto controller face restoration of the omitted tax through personal assets, travel bans, director disqualification, and imprisonment for evasion, even where the corporate entity has been struck off or transferred to a new nominee.
